item.title: 5 of the best and 4 of the worst gameday outfits Travis Kelce has worn this football season
item.description: Before each Kansas City Chiefs game, Travis Kelce shows his style. His looks for the 2025 season included designer sunglasses and a suit with shorts.

item.title: No single piece of tech is going to defeat all drone threats, new US counter-drone force commander says
item.description: Small drones are "the defining threat of our time," Brig. Gen. Ross said, requiring a layered defense network to stop them.

item.title: Meet Barry Pollack, Nicolás Maduro's lawyer who also represented Julian Assange
item.description: Barry Pollack has a long track record of sensitive cases involving national security, and of defending corporate executives in criminal trials.

item.title: How to get Rod Stewart tickets: US tour dates and prices compared

item.title: DHS said ICE agents' Hilton reservations were canceled at an independently owned Hampton Inn

item.title: Stanford neuroscientist Andrew Huberman says one morning habit sets the tone for his day
item.description: The "Huberman Lab" podcast host says good health comes down to "intentionally high cortisol in the morning and intentionally low cortisol at night."

item.title: Trump says the US could pay American oil companies for work in Venezuela
item.description: Companies' Venezuela operations would need a "tremendous amount" of investment, Trump said on Monday.
